speed.notes: 30 feet, fly 100 feet, swim 50 feet; water walk;

traits.name: Vortex
traits.text: (aura, water); 40 feet. Water in the aura that's also in the same body of water as the dragon is difficult terrain for Swimming creatures which don't have the water trait.

traits.name: Liquefy
traits.text: ⬲ (abjuration, arcane, water); Trigger The dragon is targeted by a Strike or spell that could deal fire or physical damage to them Effect The dragon liquefies, turning entirely to water while maintaining their shape, for a split second. Against the triggering effect, they gain resistance 20 to fire and to all physical damage.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.text: ⬺ (arcane, evocation, water); The dragon shoots a ball of water that deals 13d6 (13d6) bludgeoning damage in a 25-foot burst within 50 feet (DC 32 basic Reflex save). All non-magical fire in the radius is extinguished. The dragon can't use Breath Weapon again for 1d4 (1d4) rounds.

traits.name: Coiling Frenzy
traits.text: ⬺ The dragon makes one claw Strike and one tail Strike in either order, each against the same target. If either Strike hits, the dragon automatically Grabs the target.

traits.name: Draconic Momentum
traits.text: The dragon recharges their Breath Weapon whenever they score a critical hit with a Strike.

traits.name: Hyponatremia
traits.text: (water); A living creature that takes damage from the sea dragon's jaws Strike must succeed at a DC 32 Fortitude save or become sickened 1 as a surge of excess water floods its body.

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ jaws +26 (magical, reach 15 feet); Damage 3d10+12 (3d10+12) piercing plus hyponatremia

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ claw +26 (agile, magical, reach 10 feet); Damage 3d8+12 (3d8+12) slashing plus Grab

actions.name: Melee
actions.text: ⬻ tail +26 (magical, reach 25 feet); Damage 3d8+12 (3d8+12) bludgeoning plus Grab
